name: Agreement buys nothing: the physical noise floor
criteria: Twenty-two mornings agreeing exactly on eight centimetres stay refused, recording twenty-two mornings and seven people.
The standard error stored for the height is the physical floor, not the agreement of the reports.
The stored se field carries the floored error everywhere, never the raw sample error.
No gate becomes easier to pass as the spread of its input drops.
scope_note: correction-file.ts is an unavoidable storage seam beyond the roadmap list: the contract requires the persisted se field, not only the transient gate decision, to carry se_gate.
acceptance: runLearningFitOnce receives 22 identical -0.08 m residuals from seven reporters and must persist se = 0.5 * 0.48 / sqrt(22), refuse G3, and reject a controlled zero-error/applied mutation.
